title: We can still stop California's 3D printer surveillance scheme
summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation is calling for public action to oppose California's proposed legislation that would implement surveillance measures on 3D printers, potentially requiring tracking or monitoring of 3D printed objects and devices.
problem_solved: Raises awareness and mobilizes opposition to prevent the implementation of invasive 3D printer surveillance requirements under proposed California law.
why_valuable: Protects individual privacy rights and prevents government overreach into personal manufacturing by alerting citizens to contact their representatives before the legislation passes.
